claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: TC2559 is a nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (CHRNA4/alpha4beta2) agonist with no known cytotoxic pharmacophore, and at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive rather than to kill cells.
